title: Why Ferrari Swore It Would Never Build an SUV
description:
In twenty sixteen, Ferrari's chief executive Sergio Marchionne said that if Ferrari ever built an SUV, you would have to shoot him first. In September twenty twenty-two, Ferrari revealed the Purosangue, a four-door, four-seat car with a V twelve. Its chief executive asked people not to call it an SUV. This is the story of how the answer changed, and of what the sources do and do not say about why. We rely on Wikipedia, Autoevolution, Autocar, Autocar India, Drive dot com dot au, NBC, Bloomberg, Carscoops, Robb Report, Motor1 and Autohled. Several articles are undated, and some sources disagree on timing. Where they conflict, we show both. Where our sources are silent about a motive, we say so.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
